title: outskirts configuration, format 2
description: Configuration file of outskirts that declares 'version: 2', with the options grouped by section. A file without 'version', or with 'version: 1', uses the format 1 that outskirts.schema.json describes.

extends.description: Configuration files with 'version: 2' whose values this file starts from, relative to this file. A later file overrides an earlier one, and this file overrides them all; their 'overrides' come first.

overrides.description: Settings for the declarations of some modules or files instead of the top-level ones; a later entry overrides an earlier one.

modules.description: Target name globs: the entry applies to the declarations of these modules.

paths.description: Source file globs, relative to this file: the entry applies to the declarations of these files. With 'modules', both must match.

public.description: Retain the public declarations, or stop retaining them.

rules.description: Rules to turn off, or back on after an earlier entry turned them off; a rule off at the top level cannot be turned on.
Rules to check, by id: on or off.

unused.description: On by default. Always checked, cannot be turned off yet.

unused-parameter.description: On by default. Always checked, cannot be turned off yet.

redundant-protocol.description: On by default. Always checked, cannot be turned off yet.

redundant-conformance.description: On by default. Always checked, cannot be turned off yet.

retain.description: Declarations kept although they look unused.

public.description: Retain all public declarations, for framework and library projects. v1: retain_public.

public_modules.description: Modules whose public declarations are retained. v1: retain_public_modules.

public_excluded_spis.description: Public SPIs analyzed even when public declarations are retained. v1: no_retain_spi.

files.description: Source file globs whose declarations are all retained. v1: retain_files.

attributes.description: Attributes (without the @) whose declarations are retained, optionally '<attribute>:kind1,kind2'. v1: retain_attributes.

objc.description: Declarations exposed to Objective-C that are retained: 'annotated' (@objc / @objcMembers), 'accessible' (also implicitly exposed), a list of both, or 'off'. v1: retain_objc_annotated, retain_objc_accessible.

js_accessible.description: Retain protocols that inherit JSExport and their members. v1: retain_js_accessible.

properties_of.description: Protocols whose conforming types keep all their properties. v1: retain_codable_properties, retain_encodable_properties, retain_equatable_properties, retain_hashable_properties.

assign_only_property_types.description: Property types retained when assigned but never read. v1: retain_assign_only_property_types.

external_codable_protocols.description: External protocols that inherit Codable. v1: external_codable_protocols.

external_encodable_protocols.description: External protocols that inherit Encodable. v1: external_encodable_protocols.

external_test_case_classes.description: XCTestCase subclasses that live in external targets. v1: external_test_case_classes.

unused_protocol_parameters.description: Retain unused protocol function parameters. v1: retain_unused_protocol_func_params.

unused_parameters_without_default.description: Retain unused function parameters that have no default value. v1: retain_unused_parameters_without_default.

imported_modules.description: Imported modules retained even when unused. v1: retain_unused_imported_modules.

synthesized_uses.description: Retain stored properties of types described through reflection. v1: retain_synthesized_uses.

platform_conditional.description: How declarations possibly used by a build missing from the index are retained. v1: platform_conditional_retention, and disable_platform_conditional_retention for 'off'.

localized_string_keys.description: Key patterns (globs, or regular expressions between slashes) of String Catalog keys used dynamically. v1: localized_string_key_patterns.

localized_string_literals.description: Retain localized string keys equal to any string literal of the source. v1: localized_string_key_literal_match.

runtime_localized_keys.description: Retain every key that a localized string key built at runtime may look up. v1: retain_runtime_localized_keys.

index.description: Source file globs left out of indexing. v1: index_exclude.

index_defaults.description: Keep the default index globs (**/*?.build/**/*, **/SourcePackages/checkouts/**) next to 'index'.

report.description: Source file globs left out of the results; the files are still indexed. v1: report_exclude.

targets.description: Targets left out of indexing. v1: exclude_targets.

tests.description: Leave test targets out of indexing. v1: exclude_tests.

localized_string_catalogs.description: String Catalog globs left out of the localized strings analysis. v1: localized_string_catalog_exclude.

analysis.description: Options of the rules that take more than on or off.

redundant_public_members.description: Also find redundant public accessibility on the members of public types and extensions. v1: enable_redundant_public_members.

unused_system_imports.description: Also analyze imports of system frameworks (experimental). v1: enable_unused_system_imports.

unused_type_parameters.description: Also report unused generic parameters of types. v1: report_unused_type_parameters.

unconstructed_enum_cases.description: Find enum cases that are only matched in patterns and never constructed. v1: enable_unconstructed_enum_case_analysis.

metal_functions.description: Find Metal functions that no Swift string literal names. v1: detect_unused_metal_functions.

path.description: Path to the .xcodeproj or .xcworkspace. v1: project.

skip_schemes_validation.description: Do not check that the schemes exist. v1: skip_schemes_validation.

package_manifest.description: Package manifest as JSON. v1: json_package_manifest_path.

generic_config.description: Project configuration file for other build systems. v1: generic_project_config.

build.description: The build and the index store.

arguments.description: Arguments passed to swift build or xcodebuild. v1: build_arguments.

skip.description: Skip the build step. v1: skip_build.

clean.description: Remove existing build artifacts before building. v1: clean_build.

index_store_paths.description: Index store paths, relative to the project root; implies 'skip'. v1: index_store_path.

strict_index.description: Fail when a source file is newer than its index data. v1: strict_index.

cache_max_age_days.description: Age in days after which unused Xcode build caches are evicted; 0 disables the rule. v1: cache_max_age_days.

cache_max_size_gb.description: Total size in gigabytes above which the least recently used Xcode build caches are evicted; 0 disables the limit. v1: cache_max_size_gb.

format.description: Output format of the results. v1: format.

include.description: Source file globs kept in the results; supersedes exclude.report. v1: report_include.

relative.description: Report paths relative to the project root, or to 'relative_to'. v1: relative_results.

relative_to.description: Directory the result paths are relative to. v1: relative_results_base.

changed_since.description: Report only the results in files changed since this git ref. v1: changed_since.

changed_lines.description: With 'changed_since', report only the results on changed lines. v1: changed_lines.

write.description: Also write the formatted results to this file. v1: write_results.

skip_stdout.description: Do not print the results to stdout; requires 'write'. v1: skip_stdout_results.

strict.description: Exit with status 1 if any result is reported. v1: strict.

quiet.description: Print only the results. v1: quiet.

update_check.description: Check for a new version. v1: disable_update_check, inverted.

path.description: Baseline file whose entries are hidden from the results. v1: baseline.

write.description: Write the results to this baseline file. v1: write_baseline.

format.description: Ids written to the baseline: v1 the declaration USRs, v2 the output v2 ids, which include the rule. v1: baseline_format.

prune.description: Rewrite the baseline keeping only the entries that still match. v1: prune_baseline.

strict.description: Exit with status 1 if the baseline holds entries that no longer match. v1: strict_baseline.

variants.description: Builds to scan together: 'default', 'auto', or a list of variants. v1: variants.
